english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when someone is believed to be controlled by an evil spirit.

examples.english: They suddenly became possessed last night and yelled at everyone at home.
examples.traditional: 佢尋晚突然鬼上身，喺屋企亂咁鬧人。
